Shift-Click Villager Trading

In vanilla Minecraft, shift-clicking an item in your inventory while a villager's trading screen is open does nothing useful — it just shuffles the item between your inventory rows. This mod changes that.

With this mod installed, shift-clicking any item from your inventory while trading with a villager will attempt to insert it into the left (primary) trade input slot. This makes it fast and easy to load up the ingredient you want to trade without having to manually drag and drop.

The existing vanilla behavior is preserved in every other way: shift-clicking the result/output slot to collect your trade reward still works as normal.

What changed:

Shift-click on a player inventory slot while in the villager trade screen now inserts the item into the left trade input slot
If the input slot is already full, the item is returned to your inventory
Vanilla behavior:

Shift-clicking player inventory slots in the villager trade screen moves items between inventory rows — it does not interact with the trade slots at all
